title: GARDEN: Generalist Autonomous Reward Design Through Evidence Navigation for Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.37926v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) enables teams of agents, such as robots and autonomous vehicles, to learn coordinated behavior, but what such teams learn is largely determined by their reward function. Because task success alone provides too little guidance for learning, intermediate rewards are usually designed by hand, and this effort must often be repeated whenever the environment or the team changes. Large language models (LLMs) can automate the effort by writing reward functions as code, yet the resulting rewards are typically designed and tested in a single setting. To enable their reuse across settings, GARDEN (Generalist Autonomous Reward Design through Evidence Navigation) is proposed, in which one reward program is developed for a family of related scenarios and transferred, unchanged, to scenarios that were not available during its design. translated_title: GARDEN：通过证据导航实现协作多智能体强化学习的通用自主奖励设计
translated_abstract: 协作多智能体强化学习（MARL）使机器人、自动驾驶车辆等智能体团队能够学习协调行为，但这些团队学到什么在很大程度上取决于其奖励函数。由于仅靠任务成功提供的引导信息太少，中间奖励通常需要人工设计，而且每当环境或团队发生变化时，这项工作往往需要重复进行。大语言模型（LLM）可以通过将奖励函数编写为代码来自动化这一工作，但由此产生的奖励通常只在单一环境中设计和测试。为了使这些奖励能够跨环境复用，本文提出了GARDEN（通过证据导航实现通用自主奖励设计），其中一个奖励程序针对一组相关场景开发，并可原封不动地迁移到设计时不可用的场景中。在开发过程中，环境代码、训练记录和智能体……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: GARDEN提出利用大语言模型针对一组相关场景开发通用奖励程序，并可将其原封不动地迁移到设计时未见的场景，从而实现协作多智能体强化学习中奖励函数的跨环境复用。
en_tdlr: GARDEN uses LLMs to develop a single reward program for a family of related MARL scenarios and transfer it unchanged to unseen scenarios, enabling reusable automated reward design for cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning.
